cinder_imp.caption: one squat charcoal imp, large round belly, short blunt horns, long arms, thin tail, ember eyes, orange belly cracks

ash_knight.caption: one stocky knight in ash-covered blackened plate, warped closed pointed helmet, dim orange visor, charred tabard, holding a heavy broad straight sword

fire_wisp.caption: one floating irregular cluster of dark clinker rock fragments surrounding a glowing amber-white core, small flame plume above, faceless glowing rock

dwarf_furnace_deserter.caption: one short stout blacksmith dwarf, singed copper beard, hinged iron faceguard, soot armor, brown leather apron, holding long metal pincers

goblin_scrapper.caption: one short olive-gray goblin in mismatched rusty scrap armor, huge crooked shoulder plate, one squinting eye, tool apron, holding a long hooked salvage pole

foundries_slag_slug.caption: one broad low amorphous mound of molten brown-black slag slime, irregular clinker plates on its back, narrow orange glowing underside, flat trailing lip

foundries_bellows_brute.caption: one stocky riveted iron robot, round vented faceless head, accordion leather bellows chest, short piston legs, one blunt arm, one broad furnace rake arm

furnace_king.caption: one massive barrel-chested black iron golem, chimney crown, amber visor, grated orange furnace door chest, thick hinged limbs, huge square forge hammer
